landing_faq_backend_answer: Yes. Taskora stores everything in your browser’s local storage, so there is nothing to sign up for. Data is not synced between devices, so export a backup from Settings when you need one.
landing_faq_backend_question: Can I manage tasks without a backend or an account?
landing_faq_features_answer: Projects, Kanban boards, task lists, a calendar, the My Day planner, Focus Mode, template-based Smart Planner, productivity insights, a command palette, light and dark themes, and JSON export and import.
landing_faq_focus_answer: Pick a task, start a focus timer (25 minutes by default) and take a short break when it ends. Completed sessions are saved to your history and appear in Insights. The timer keeps correct time even if you switch tabs or reload the page.
landing_faq_languages_answer: English, Hindi and Gujarati. You can switch at any time from the menu on this page or in Settings; your choice is remembered. Task and project names you type are never changed.
landing_faq_what_answer: Taskora is a productivity workspace for planning projects, managing tasks, organizing your day and working in focused sessions. It runs entirely in your web browser.
landing_feature_focus_description: A distraction-free timer for focus and break sessions, linked to the task you are working on.
landing_feature_insights_description: Charts and a daily heatmap built from the tasks you complete and the sessions you log.
landing_feature_kanban_description: Move tasks from backlog to done with drag and drop, including full keyboard support.
